name: causal_rag
title: Causal RAG: hypothesis and testing agents on the CauseTrace graph
description: A hypothesis agent proposes up to six signed cause-and-effect chains for the month; a testing agent (three seeds, majority vote) labels each Supported, Contradicted or Insufficient against the CauseTrace claims graph. Per fund the stated view is the signed count of Supported chains (F_S); F_C and F_I are features. For two funds IEF's signals stand in for TLT. Exploratory: run on a free stand-in model (qwen3:4b) whose reliability gates failed.
author: Claire, Farnoosh
